name: Clockwork Town
lore: A town that runs on gears and steam: clockwork owls and wind-up mice, robot pets, ticking clocks and pocket watches, a steam train, a submarine and a zeppelin, all in brass and copper.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's Clockwork Town (steampunk brass and gears: clockwork animals, little robots, clocks, trains; Peter's 10/13 framing rule; busy scenes, AI lettering and a blue engine near Thomas the Tank Engine left out), 32 picks and 16 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/14-clockwork-town/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace 7bd77d0: 4 dropped on lane D's phase-1 bake and pre-read, ct010 on its other seed); lane C edited many of them (a tighter crop, the plain background split into an orange sky band and a slate ground band; the edit field, ops in edits.json; the file <id>e.png). Kind painting, shade on, converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). Refill (lane C a0bad2b): critic-land-14's drops ct021 ct044 ct013 ct033 ct049 ct035 out, 7 portraits in a real setting added (ids ct2NN, no edit), 33 picks and 22 spares. The 55 manifest lines are lane C's, whole; lane D filled only the empty url with the licence row's source in Dino Valley's words. The folder keeps lane C's slug (14); as installed it is Land 11 in the factory's numbering (era 19) and Zen World 12.
